item.title: Canada Spousal Support Guidelines -
item.description: In Canada, the federal Spousal Support Advisory Guidelines provide a framework for calculating spousal support. They are not legally binding.

item.title: Canada Impaired Driving Laws and Penalties -
item.description: Drinking alcohol or using drugs and operating a vehicle is a serious criminal offence in Canada. It is the leading criminal cause of death and injury in Canada

item.title: Canada Sexual Assault Laws and Penalties -
item.description: Sexual Assault is a Very Serious Crime in Canada. Section 271 of the Canadian Criminal Code under refers to non-consensual sexual contact.

item.title: Canada Common Assault Laws and Penalties -
item.description: In Canada, common assault is intentionally applying force to another person without their consent or threatening to do so. Penalty could be 5 years imprisonment

item.title: Canada Family Violence Laws and Penalties -
item.description: Penalties for domestic violence can be as high as 10 years jail time if the assault involved a weapon or caused bodily harm, summary conviction or indictment.

item.title: Divorce Family Property Division in Canada -
item.description: Properties acquired during the marriage are the family's property and belong equally to both spouses, unless an agreement or circumstances dictate otherwise.

item.title: Canada Family Justice Services -
item.description: Are you are dealing with separation, divorce, or other family law issues? See Canada justice services that can help you resolve issues without going to court.

item.title: Child and Spousal Support Judgements -
item.description: Key Canadian cases on child and spousal support. The case law in this area changes frequently and we do not update this page. Please consult a lawyer.
